next_step: Run evals-driven A/B canary: new embedder + reranker on 50k doc shard; collect quality delta + latency metrics
notes:
Context: enterprise legal-tech search platform. Heavy index — ~18M documents (contracts, briefs, precedents). Primary pain: cost per query + tail latency under 200ms for embedded reranking.

Key ask: migrate embeddings + learn-to-rank reranker to reduce cost and improve MRR/top-5 accuracy. Team worried about quality regressions after embedder change — must prove parity via evals and human review. Interested in canary + A/B rollout tooling and automatic fallback to current model when drift detected.

Quote from CTO on 2026-02-18 call: "We can accept a 5% throughput hit but not a 3% drop in top-3 precision for legal citations."

Security: must run inside VPC with customer-managed KMS and per-query audit logs archived for 7 years. Data residency: primary NA with EU contract data on EU-only nodes.

Procurement: legal and security review underway; procurement expects final POC report before SOW.

Preferences: open-model friendly but needs validated quantized variants for on-prem GPUs. Looking for recommendation on batching configs, KV cache sizing, and index sharding for 18M docs.

Stated success criteria for migration POC:
- embedding cosine recall @10 >= current baseline (within 0.5% absolute)
- reranker MRR delta <= 1% absolute
- p50 latency <= 120ms, p95 <= 250ms (query path)
- cost/query reduced >= 25% on committed Dedicated nodes

Notes on evals: planning a two-week human-in-the-loop eval over 4k queries (golden set + long-tail) + automated reg tests (evals harness) that gate rollout. Want Redwood Optimize to surface regression alerts per eval metric and support rollbacks.
